slow_release.name: Release Package vs. Press
slow_release.focus: Get off the line faster against contact
slow_release.description: Line up vs a jam bag/partner at the LOS. Practice hesi-swim, one-arm rip, and hip-dip releases, resetting after each rep. 4 sets x 6 reps per release type.

wide_break_radius.name: 3-Cone Speed-Cut Drill
wide_break_radius.focus: Tighten cuts and reduce false steps at the break
wide_break_radius.description: Set 3 cones in an L. Sprint, plant, and cut at full speed focusing on a 3-step cut (not rounding). 6 reps, alternating break direction.

rounded_route_stem.name: Stick-the-Foot Ladder Drill
rounded_route_stem.focus: Vertical stem discipline before the break
rounded_route_stem.description: Run a 45-degree stem to a marked depth cone, drive the plant foot straight into the ground, and snap the hips before breaking. Emphasize no drift off the vertical line pre-break.

low_separation_at_catch.name: Route-and-Finish Tempo Drill
low_separation_at_catch.focus: Maintain/create separation through the catch point
low_separation_at_catch.description: Full-speed route vs. a trail defender with a QB throwing on rhythm. Focus on accelerating out of the break instead of settling, tracking the ball late.

inconsistent_top_speed.name: Flying 20s
inconsistent_top_speed.description: 10-yard build-up into a timed 20-yard fly at max speed. 6-8 reps with full recovery, focus on arm drive and stride length.

telegraphing_break.name: Mirror Release Drill
telegraphing_break.focus: Disguise the break so the DB can't jump it
telegraphing_break.description: Partner mirrors your first 5 steps. Practice keeping shoulders/eyes neutral (not dipping early) until the actual plant step.

slow_transition.name: Backpedal-to-Drive (W-Drill)
slow_transition.focus: React and close faster out of the backpedal
slow_transition.description: Backpedal on a whistle/cone, then break at a 45-degree angle to a second cone, then to a third. Focus on hip snap and first-step quickness out of the plant, not the backpedal speed itself.

over_committing_to_stem.name: Eyes-In Zone Read Drill
over_committing_to_stem.description: Backpedal reading a QB/coach's shoulders instead of the WR's stem. React only to the throw/route break, not the release.

poor_press_technique.name: Jam-and-Mirror Drill
poor_press_technique.focus: Disrupt the release at the line
poor_press_technique.description: Line up press vs a WR release partner. Practice a two-hand jam with proper base width and hip control, then mirror the release for 5 yards without opening the gate early.

high_separation_allowed.name: Trail Technique Drill
high_separation_allowed.focus: Close the cushion through the route
high_separation_allowed.description: Run routes in trail position (slightly behind, inside leverage), working to close to a half-yard cushion by the top of the route without grabbing.

grabby_at_break.name: Hands-Down Phase Drill
grabby_at_break.focus: Play the man/ball without a penalty risk
grabby_at_break.description: Mirror the WR's break with hands at the hip until the ball is thrown, then play through the hands only at the catch point.

late_recognition.name: Route Recognition Reps
late_recognition.description: Watch cut-ups of the top 5 route stems for this opponent/position group; call out the route out loud within the first 3 steps of the stem.
